title: Tarnobrzeg win 13-2 in Cartagena as Metz and Etival stay unbeaten in ETTU Champions League Women
seo_title: Champions League Women: Tarnobrzeg win 13-2 in Cartagena
description: Tarnobrzeg beat Cartagena 13-2 on games in the ETTU Champions League Women, while Metz beat Saint-Quentin 10-5 and Etival beat Hodonín 11-4 on Saturday.
standfirst: Han Ying and He Zhuojia won all four of their matches for the top seeds, and Hana Goda won six games as Metz came from behind against Saint-Quentin.
body: KTS Enea Siarkopol Tarnobrzeg lost only two of 15 games in beating UCAM Cartagena 13-2 in Spain on Saturday, while Metz and Etival both won again to stay unbeaten in the ETTU Champions League Women.

The top seeds had started Stage 2 with an [8-7 home defeat by Etival](/news/ettu-champions-league-women-2026-27-stage-2-round-1-etival-beat-tarnobrzeg.html) on Tuesday. In Cartagena they answered it emphatically, winning the first two matches without dropping a game and never giving the hosts a way back. Metz beat their French rivals Saint-Quentin 10-5 at home, and Etival beat Hodonín 11-4.
## Han concedes 14 points in her second match

Germany's Han Ying, the 43-year-old defender who is ranked 16th in the world, set the tone by beating Spain's Maria Xiao 11-3, 11-7, 11-6. China's He Zhuojia, the world No 48, followed by beating England's Tin-Tin Ho 11-9, 11-3, 11-3.

Cartagena's two games both came in deciders. Chile's Daniela Ortega took the second game against Monaco's Xiaoxin Yang before losing 12-10, 8-11, 11-5, and Xiao won the first game against He before He took the next two 11-4, 11-7. Han finished the night against Ho, winning 11-4, 11-4, 11-6 and conceding 14 points in three games.

It was a hard evening for Ho, the world No 85, who had won her second match for Cartagena in [their opening win in Hodonín](/news/ettu-champions-league-women-2026-27-stage-2-round-1-etival-beat-tarnobrzeg.html) on Tuesday.
## Goda wins six games for Metz

Egypt's Hana Goda, the world No 21, won both her matches for Metz without losing a game, although the first was close. She beat Canada's Mo Zhang 12-10, 13-11, 11-8, and later beat Saint-Quentin's Camille Lutz 11-4, 11-4, 11-5.

In between, Saint-Quentin went ahead. Camille beat her sister Charlotte, the Metz player ranked 66th in the world, 14-12, 13-11, 7-11, and Russia's Polina Mikhailova beat Croatia's Lea Rakovac 11-8, 14-12, 11-7 to leave the visitors 5-4 up. Goda's win over Camille put Metz 7-5 ahead, and Charlotte then beat Zhang 11-8, 11-7, 11-8 to finish the night.

Metz had [come from 6-2 down to win 9-6 in Berlin](/news/ettu-champions-league-women-2026-27-stage-2-berlin-metz.html) on Wednesday. Saint-Quentin had won every match against Linz AG Froschberg in round one.
## Etival make it two from two

Australia's Yangzi Liu and Sweden's Christina Källberg won all four of their matches for Etival against SKST Plus Hodonín. Liu beat Karin Grofova 11-7, 11-6, 8-11, and Källberg beat Marketa Sevcikova 12-10, 11-0, 11-0.

China's Zhang Binyue won Hodonín's only match, beating Portugal's Jieni Shao 11-8, 11-7, 7-11. Liu then beat Sevcikova 11-0, 11-0, 11-0, so Sevcikova did not win a point in her last five games of the night, and Källberg came from a game down to beat Grofova 9-11, 13-11, 11-7.

- UCAM Cartagena 2-13 KTS Enea Siarkopol Tarnobrzeg: Han Ying bt Maria Xiao 11-3, 11-7, 11-6; He Zhuojia bt Tin-Tin Ho 11-9, 11-3, 11-3; Xiaoxin Yang bt Daniela Ortega 12-10, 8-11, 11-5; He Zhuojia bt Maria Xiao 9-11, 11-4, 11-7; Han Ying bt Tin-Tin Ho 11-4, 11-4, 11-6
- Metz TT 10-5 Saint-Quentin TT: Hana Goda bt Mo Zhang 12-10, 13-11, 11-8; Camille Lutz bt Charlotte Lutz 14-12, 13-11, 7-11; Polina Mikhailova bt Lea Rakovac 11-8, 14-12, 11-7; Hana Goda bt Camille Lutz 11-4, 11-4, 11-5; Charlotte Lutz bt Mo Zhang 11-8, 11-7, 11-8
- Etival ASRTT 11-4 SKST Plus Hodonín: Yangzi Liu bt Karin Grofova 11-7, 11-6, 8-11; Christina Källberg bt Marketa Sevcikova 12-10, 11-0, 11-0; Zhang Binyue bt Jieni Shao 11-8, 11-7, 7-11; Yangzi Liu bt Marketa Sevcikova 11-0, 11-0, 11-0; Christina Källberg bt Karin Grofova 9-11, 13-11, 11-7

Metz and Etival lead the group of eight with two wins each and 19 games won to 11. Tarnobrzeg have one win and the best games difference so far, 20-10, ahead of Saint-Quentin (16-14), Cartagena (13-17) and Hodonín, who have lost both ties (8-22).

The round finishes on Sunday, when Linz AG Froschberg host TTC Berlin eastside at 4pm local time (3pm UK), with both clubs looking for their first win. Rounds three and four are on 15-16 and 19-20 December. The top two go straight to the Final Four, which Metz host on 1-2 May 2027. The table is on Eleven's [Champions League page](/clubs/champions-league.html).
